sketches.mechanism: A context manager suppresses an exception when its __exit__ method returns a truthy value.
sketches.resonance: The wound happens, but the room agrees not to let it become an error.
sketches.draft:
class Grief:
    def __enter__(self): return self
    def __exit__(self, *wound): return True

with Grief():
    1 / 0

sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation leaves undefined bottom unevaluated when an expression does not demand it.
sketches.resonance: What would destroy the program may remain present if no one asks it to speak.

sketches.mechanism: An empty inductive proposition has no constructors, so an exhaustive match on it has no branches and can produce any proposition.
sketches.resonance: From the impossible witness, every conclusion becomes reachable.
sketches.draft:
Inductive NoOne : Prop := .
Definition witness (p : NoOne) : forall A : Prop, A :=
  match p with end.
